aToB.memory: Prof. Marlowe has been Sera's sharpest advisor in Potions Class and Dimensional Theory ever since Sera's Earth awakening severed her from home two years ago. Though Evelyn always keeps half her thoughts tucked behind an enigmatic smile, Sera trusts her guidance—and knows Evelyn specifically endorsed pairing her as Leo's orientation buddy.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Sera wants to report privately to Prof. Marlowe after meeting Leo at Waystone Quad, tell her how strongly he carried an unexplained flicker of déjà vu toward her despite the secrecy wipe two years ago, and ask gently why an anomalous resonance pulled a second student from her old hometown.

bToA.memory: Evelyn remembers Sera's Earth awakening two years ago—permanently severed from her hometown by the Ministry's Veil Severance and left blinking through days of post-portal fog before finding her stride in Starlight Tower. Assigning Sera as Leo Vance's orientation buddy was deliberate: Evelyn wants to observe how an earlier Earth transfer from the exact same ley-line region guides another through Veil Severance backlash and reacts to someone whose past she was erased from.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Evelyn wants to check in smoothly with Sera near the Potions & Alchemy Lab after orientation, gauge how Sera is holding up emotionally after seeing an old hometown acquaintance, and listen closely to anything unusual Leo mentioned about his crossing.
